default_in_repayment.text:
The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loan or other borrowings and payment of interest thereon to any lender.

The Company has not been declared willful defaulter by any bank or financial institution  or other lender.

The Company has not taken any term loan during the year and therefore, reporting under clause 3(ix)(c) of the Order is not applicable.

On an overall examination of the Standalone Financial Statements of the Company, funds raised on short-term basis have, prima facie, not been used during the year for long-term purposes by the Company. According to the information and explanation given to us, as Company is engaged in the business of supply of natural gas, being public utility, security deposits from the customers, though shown as current liability, the company does not consider the same as short-term funds.

On an overall examination of the Standalone Financial Statements of the Company, the Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of

fraud.text:
No fraud by the Company and no material fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year. 

No report under sub-section 12 of section 143 of the Act has been filed in Form ADT – 4 as prescribed under rule 13 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government of India, during the year and up to the date of this report.

As represented to us by the Management, there are no whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year.

statutory_dues.text: In our opinion, the Company is generally regular in depositing the undisputed statutory dues, including goods and service tax, value added tax, excise, provident fund, employee’s state insurance, income tax, and other material statutory dues, as applicable, with appropriate authorities. As explained to us, the Company did not have any dues on account of duty of customs.

call_points.text: Morbi gas run-rate is about 3 mmscmd post-July, with propane supplying 5.3-5.4 mmscmd equivalent.
Sourcing mix is about 20% term, 12.5% domestic and 67% spot; half the term volumes are Henry Hub linked.
Cash on the balance sheet is about ₹7,200 Cr; deployment plan to be shared by Q3.
About ₹900 Cr of tax refunds expected from merger losses, at least a year away.
Power PLFs near 1% at both plants; GSEG at 6% and Pipavav at 1% last quarter.
GSPL Transmission listing without a public issue needs BSE, NSE and SEBI exemption, expected early September.
CGD capex is guided at close to INR1,000 crores, with E&P capex around INR100 crores.
Morbi ceramic cluster volume reached close to 8 mmscmd by May 2026 due to tight propane supplies.

operating_notes.text: Morbi gas consumption recovered to 2.70 mmscmd across 290 units by April 22, 2026, from 0.36 mmscmd on March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 consolidated exceptional items were a ₹146.57 Cr expense; FY26 total ₹149.81 Cr.
Auditor flagged non-provision of ₹1,688.66 Cr disputed income-tax demands and a ₹1,200 Cr Vedanta claim as contingent liabilities.
Gas Transmission business demerged into GSPL Transmission Limited with appointed date 1 April 2025; MCA order dated 8 April 2026, effective 1 May 2026.
Q4FY26 CNG volume reached 3.60 mmscmd, up 12% YoY.
Gujarat Gas Limited renamed to Gujarat Energy Limited effective May 14, 2026.
Morbi cluster averaged 5.67 mmscmd in Q1FY27 and non-Morbi industrial 2.04 mmscmd; post-July Morbi gas run-rate is about 3 mmscmd.
CGD sourcing mix: about 14% APM, 6% new well gas, 2% GAIL pool, 9% long-term contract and 69% short-term or inter-segment.
Total pipeline network spans about 45,900 km across six states and one union territory, with 844 CNG stations.

timeline.summary: On April 23, 2026, Gujarat Gas reported measures to support the revival of the Morbi ceramic industry with assured gas supply and pricing.
On April 29, 2026, Gujarat Gas fixed May 12, 2026, as the record date for issuing scheme shares and updated its name to Gujarat Energy Limited.
Gujarat Energy completed its Composite Scheme of Arrangement on May 1, 2026, amalgamating GSPC, GSPL, and GEL, and demerging transmission operations.
On May 16, 2026, Gujarat Energy approved the allotment of 62.27 crore equity shares pursuant to its scheme of arrangement.
Gujarat Gas Limited’s promoters, group, and concerted persons confirmed no encumbrance on 13,32,235 equity shares during FY2026.
Gujarat State Petronet Ltd. confirmed no encumbrance on Gujarat Gas Limited shares held during FY2025-26, as per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,002.4 Cr (+39.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹351.24 Cr.
On May 30, 2026, Gujarat Energy reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹5,976 Cr and EBITDA of ₹943 Cr, proposing a dividend of ₹8.90 per share.
On May 1, 2026, Gujarat Gas completed the GSPC Group Composite Scheme of Arrangement, changing its name to Gujarat Energy Limited.
Gujarat Gas Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4-FY26 earnings conference call held on June 1, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST.

Gujarat Gas Limited’s promoters—Government of Gujarat, Gujarat State Petroleum Corporation Limited, Gujarat State Petronet Limited, and Gujarat State Energy Generation Limited—declared no encumbrances on shares for FY2025–26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
On June 5, 2026, Gujarat Energy filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on June 1, 2026.
Gujarat Energy paid record ₹324 Cr dividend to Gujarat government for FY 25-26, highest ever by a state PSU
